description:
Measured while landing fz-f98.21: two processes running --dump native on
fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz write files that differ at char
59,803 of 98,141 (HashMap Debug order is per-process RandomState order), even
though the underlying programs are equal. --dump backend was the same disease
and now emits the canonical form (fz-kdt.6, absorbed by fz-f98.21); native and
fnir are the only dumps left that cannot be diffed run to run.

Fix: extend compiler2/canon.rs to NativeProgram (fnir is its .module
projection). The machinery (id-free labels, TyCanon, index remapping, sorted
map rendering) already exists; dump.rs:126-127 are the two {:#?} sites.
title: dump native/fnir are {:#?}: non-reproducible across processes
